scientific_target: Phase-blind determination of whether a scalar lowest-state loop around the D5h conical intersection can cross each of the five symmetry-related spokes with the pre-existing 2e-4 Eh internal-gap safety margin.

antecedent.interpretation: The previous run stopped before phase exposure because the circular central loop had a reproducible approximately 1.14e-5 Eh minimum gap on five 72-degree-related spokes while all point-quality checks passed.

locked_model.point_seed: the same frozen cc-pVTZ D5h SA2 center for every point

surfaces.anchor_definition: The D5h center and five frozen relaxed secondary-CI replica geometries from PASS_CCPVTZ_SECONDARY_CI_LIFT.
surfaces.cone_v1: DeltaR(r,theta)=r sum_m c_m exp(i m theta)
surfaces.smooth_quadratic: DeltaR(r,theta)=r sum_|m|=1 c_m exp(i m theta)+r^2[c_0+sum_|m|=2 c_m exp(i m theta)]

direction_roles.0.0: spoke from the center toward a secondary CI

decision_rules.STOP_SCREEN_WAVEFUNCTION_FAILURE: At least one of the 40 points fails a locked electronic or geometry quality gate.
decision_rules.STOP_V1_REPRODUCTION_FAILURE: The independently recalculated cone-v1 r=0.45 controls do not reproduce the frozen antecedent points within the declared tolerance.
decision_rules.PROMOTE_SMOOTH_SURFACE_TO_ANGULAR_QUALIF: The smooth surface, but not the cone surface, has a sampled spoke point with gap at least 2e-4 Eh; authorize a separate full-angle loop qualification without phase.
decision_rules.PROMOTE_CONE_SURFACE_TO_ANGULAR_QUALIFIC: The cone surface, but not the smooth surface, has a sampled spoke point with gap at least 2e-4 Eh; authorize a separate full-angle loop qualification without phase.
decision_rules.PROMOTE_BOTH_SURFACES_TO_ANGULAR_ARBITRA: Both surfaces cross the sampled spoke target; compare full angular maximin loops before selecting either surface.
decision_rules.REFINE_SPOKE_MAXIMUM_OR_PIVOT_PROJECTOR: Neither sampled spoke reaches 2e-4 Eh; do not run a scalar phase. Refine the phase-blind spoke maximum or pivot to rank-2 projector topology.

publication_policy.authorized_scope: selection of the next phase-blind central-loop qualification or projector-topology protocol only
forbidden: evaluating any scalar Berry or Wilson product in this screen
lowering the 2e-4 Eh target merely because the previous circle failed
interpreting a sampled maximum as a continuous mathematical upper bound
editing or deleting the antecedent STOP decision
